app Guards
Given
 Item {ready:bool}
When
 scenario check(item:Item) by=members
  require item.ready; require item.ready
  do require item.ready; require item.ready
Then
 page / title="T"
  require members; text "Allowed"
  card "C"
   require members
   text "Body"

app Views
Given
 Item {name:text,not:text,true:text,false:text,null:text}
When
 scenario refresh() by=members
  do return true
Then
 page / title="Items" poll=5s refresh=refresh
  require members
  form Item.create import=csv review=preview
  actions refresh,Item.update
  table Item columns=not,true,false,null order=-not,true search=name
   text row.not
   delete
 page /next title="Next"
  form (Item.create)
  actions (refresh),Item.update
